text:
Lindsay Hart: Quick post-POC handoff question — ACME finished the trial today. Can we confirm the checklist to expire Hosted API keys, tear down the Dedicated pool, and what snapshots/log exports we should keep for 90-day retention? Also any billing/prorate notes? TL;DR: need checklist + owners. @Jordan can you lead?

Jordan Kim: Yep. I can lead. Need SRE confirmation on drain timing and Ops on keys/export. Also we should confirm whether ACME wants a full VM snapshot or just logs. @Maya any compliance constraints?

Tom Rivera: SRE: Recommend a 24h drain window after final traffic cut. Dedicated pools: 1) disable autoscale 2) remove routing rules 3) drain existing requests 4) delete pool. I'll write a small runbook snippet. :white_check_mark:

Samir Gupta: Ops steps (short): will rotate Hosted keys and then invalidate old ones. Export logs to secure bucket first. Example commands I will run:

```
# revoke hosted key
redwood keys revoke --key-id=ak-ACME-POC --force
# snapshot/export logs
redwood logs export --filter 'team:acme-poc' --out s3://redwood-poc-archives/acme-1919.tar.gz
# teardown dedicated pool (after drain)
redwood pools delete --pool-id=ded-acme-pochash
```

Maya Singh: Security ack: 90-day log retention is ok per SOC, but we must sanitize PII before export. Run scripts/sanitize_poc_exports.sh and include checksum + KMS audit. @Samir pls include KMS access audit in the archive metadata.

Samir Gupta: Will include KMS audit and checksum. Note: when we delete the Dedicated pool GPUs they are deprovisioned but we snapshot images. If Legal wants longer hold we can export images to an egress-controlled bucket instead of deleting immediately.

Lindsay Hart: Legal asked about a 6-month hold option in case ACME requests extended evals. @legal-bot any required paperwork?

legal-bot: No objection — create an email confirmation from ACME and tag the Zendesk ticket with `legal-hold`. Keep a minimal metadata manifest with export.

Jordan Kim: FYI for Sales: deprovisioning mid-month triggers a prorated credit for Dedicated reserved capacity per contract (clause 4.2). @billing-bot can you post an estimate?

billing-bot: Preliminary estimate: ~46% of monthly commit (15 days used). Will follow up with formal credit note within 24h.

Tom Rivera: I'll paste the runbook snippet here in 10m with exact commands and rollback notes.

Jordan Kim: Thanks — scheduling final drain with ACME for tomorrow 15:00 PST. After drain completes and keys are revoked, I'll post final confirmation here and attach the export link. :rocket:

deploy-bot: Job revoke-hosted-keys-191900 ran, status: success. Logs: https://deploys.redwood/job/1919005678

Jordan Kim: Confirmed — hosted keys revoked and ACME notified. Waiting on Samir for the log export upload. Will close loop after archive is uploaded and legal/billing confirm.
